name: The Bait in the Alley
summary: The bleeding stranger in the alley is the inquisitor's trap — set for whatever smells blood and comes to it.
narrative_beats: You bend toward the spilled blood. It is too fresh — unnaturally so, no sign of struggle, as if poured here with care.
A very soft step at the mouth of the alley. Not fleeing — confirming. 'See,' a gentle voice says, 'she came after all.'
The one in the case drops his tone at once: "It's a trap. Don't let your eyes change color."
player_options: Crush the thirst down and walk out as if nothing (a hard check at high thirst)
Play along, act the ordinary woman frightened by blood (your acting against his watching)
Have the Maestro play a note to scatter the scene and slip away (escape, but confirms 'strange doings')
consequences: Either way, the inquisitor has confirmed you 'react to blood' — suspicion rises sharply, escalation reaches at least the 40–70 band.
If your eyes redden and are 'witnessed' on the spot: suspicion jumps to ≥70, and the next step is a formal interview.
